pl-l2d30c5-d1e105.summary: States that original sin, as Augustine testifies, is what passed through Adam into all begotten through concupiscence by his vitiated flesh.
claims: Original sin passes to those begotten through concupiscence.

pl-l2d30c5.summary: States that original sin, as Augustine testifies, is what passed through Adam into all who are begotten through concupiscence from his vitiated flesh.
claims: Original sin passed from Adam to all begotten through concupiscence.
It passes through Adam's vitiated flesh.
